operads/tests/integration/test_ingress_c: Complete ingress/persistence matrix reviewed. It tests YAML frontmatter example exclusion, malformed input/contract fields with zero rows, exact ordered-port digests and epoch/idempotency semantics. Identical requests intentionally replay their recorded snapshot despite changed live sources; new version/key requests recompile. Source declarations are downgraded to Unadmitted. The .agents skill/projection paths require reconciliation with current canonical-source ownership before running. No test executed.
operads/tests/integration/test_manifest_: Complete four-case HMAC mutation test reviewed. Wrong key, changed epoch, changed signer and truncated signature are tested; the all-header/non-malleability and timing prose exceeds the actual cases. Manifest ID, algorithm and delimiter-collision pairs are not exercised, leaving the already-reviewed owner's unframed message construction gap untested. Public fixture key only; no cryptographic run or private key read.
operads/tests/integration/test_openapi_s: Complete schema/docs/health tests reviewed. They assert route/model names and HTML marker availability using an in-process client; accessibility means endpoint availability here, not UI accessibility, authorization or operation semantics. Default app construction and external documentation assets are not evaluated. Not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_operad_in: Complete permutation tests reviewed. Noncommutative pair outputs, all six three-input permutations, mixed colours, mapping inputs, nullary operations and invalid bool/float/repeated/out-of-range orders test a concrete external-to-planar action. Native request binding rejects stale wire/values and guards inspect physical slots. This bounded group-action/interface battery is stronger than an equivariant label, but not a universal equivariance proof for arbitrary executors. Native cases excluded; no tests run.
operads/tests/integration/test_operad_na: Complete native/oracle differential tests reviewed. Twenty-six ordered one-colour pair trees of height at most three compare boundaries, values, occurrence counts and distinct term IDs. The runtime case forbids delegating to the Python oracle and checks invocation order; additional cases cover integer overflow, colour mismatch and missing input. This finite exact test space does not prove all trees, all interpreters or model semantics. Actual native calls were read only, not executed.
operads/tests/integration/test_operad_oc: Complete checked-occurrence tests reviewed. Host-selected typed rejection binds canonical immutable snapshots, retains executed-prefix cost/evidence and stops before parent dispatch; invalid/exception/stale checkers remain operational failures rather than checked negatives. The mutation test snapshots pre-dispatch operands, unlike the optional unchecked path. Repeated operation IDs retain distinct ordinals; model-shaped REFUSE text cannot mint a bottom receipt. Native structural-host tests are explicit and excluded from execution. These demonstrate the intended finite binding contract, not checker adequacy or truth of every rejection; not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_operad_re: Complete native realization tests reviewed. Full normal-form/occurrence/order fields are compared, decoded output copies resist alias mutation, nine tamper types refuse before effects, and checked-prefix receipts retain the whole structural model. Twenty-six finite trees plus nullary/identity and binder-failure controls bound coverage. This is a structural request/model/receipt binding battery; supplied execution semantics and host checker soundness remain assumptions. No native execution performed.
operads/tests/integration/test_outbox_me: Complete delivery tests reviewed. They cover success, failure then retry, no-subscriber retention, late subscriber recovery, bounded-poll starvation and wildcard handlers. The idempotency example manually deduplicates event IDs in a process-local set, illustrating a consumer responsibility rather than durable exactly-once effects. Multi-subscriber partial-success and shared-message mutation are not tested here. No outbox/test execution.
operads/tests/integration/test_outbox_su: Complete typed subscriber outcome matrix reviewed. Err and unknown return types remain pending; None and Ok(None) acknowledge, with reopen and recovery assertions. This sharply separates a callback's typed acceptance from an error, but None/Ok are still supplied attestations and do not prove durable external effects. Temporary SQLite fixture, not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_outbox_tr: Complete transaction rollback tests reviewed. A throwing event property forces rollback across catalogue, journal, outbox and idempotency tables; patched source enumeration tests parse failure and unreadable-file refusal. Direct rollback case is stronger than count-only happy paths. Malformed fixture checks only is_err, so an earlier boundary failure could satisfy it without reaching intended YAML parsing. No transaction executed.
operads/tests/integration/test_outbox_wo: Complete lease tests reviewed. Two connections exercise exclusion, expiry, fenced old-token acknowledgment, retry backoff and nonfinite/negative clocks. A two-process race asserts one claim; its cwd parents[3] resolves to operads, so module discovery needs checking. Lease exclusivity bounds scheduling and does not guarantee a slow external effect stops after lease expiry. No child processes or database tests run.
operads/tests/integration/test_prior_art: Complete contextual prior-art admission tests reviewed. Exact ordered ports, plan digest, source/candidate/effect-ceiling mutations and ephemeral fixture signatures bind a declared plan; the header correctly disclaims interpretation of PICARD or paper semantics. ROOT parents[3] resolves to operads and then appends operads/catalog, a stale retained-source route candidate. SSH signing and subprocess example were not executed and no governance/private key was accessed.
operads/tests/integration/test_projectio: Complete projection/HMAC test reviewed. Synthetic persisted catalogue projects to YAML and self-signs under a public test key; payload, signature and wrong-key mutations refuse. Assertions do not establish independent publisher identity, complete header binding, external authority or operation admission. The caller-created catalogue contains admitted/verified labels without bound mathematical evidence. No signing/test execution.
operads/tests/integration/test_raw_ingre: Complete native raw-receipt tests reviewed. Equivalent JSON retains distinct raw identities, request context/transplants and report/implementation mutations refuse, strict malformed inputs reject, and detection stays AuthorityEffect None. These test receipt replay/binding, not completeness or false-positive rate of the persona detector. Every invocation crosses RustSymbolGameHost; all were excluded from execution.
operads/tests/integration/test_receipt_c: Complete independent chain reconstruction test reviewed. It recomputes the published BLAKE3 byte framing outside production helpers and distinguishes intact copied prefix from completeness against an externally retained tip. The final control explicitly shows that replacing custody with the current prefix tip accepts truncation. This is a useful finite trust-boundary witness, conditional on retained-tip custody and digest assumptions, not proof of authority or arbitrary concurrency. Not run.
